message.content: {"caption":"Nine-panel scatterplot comparing latency and accuracy for three pipeline components across three evaluation metrics, with results for the Base, PPO, and GRPO models.","description":"The chart is arranged in three columns—F1 (↑), B1 (↑), and J (↑)—and three rows: Memory Manager Accuracy (%), Memory Search Accuracy (%), and Answer Agent Accuracy (%). Each panel plots Latency (s) on the horizontal axis and accuracy on the vertical axis. Blue represents Base, orange PPO, and green GRPO. Circles mark p50 latency and triangles mark p95 latency; a horizontal line connects each model’s two latency marks. In every panel, the p95 mark is to the right of p50. Across the metrics and components, PPO has the highest F1 read-off (about 44–45), GRPO is around 35–36, and Base is near 30–31. For B1, PPO is around 33, GRPO around 28, and Base around 22. For J, GRPO is about 60, PPO about 58, and Base about 46. The horizontal positions vary by component and model; several p95 marks are much farther right than their p50 marks.
